# SigBridgeR

## 🌐 Overview

SigBridgeR integrates multiple algorithms, using single-cell RNA
sequencing data, bulk expression data, and sample-related phenotypic
data, to identify the cells most closely associated with the phenotypic
data, performing as a bridge to existing tools.

![SigBridgeR workflow](reference/figures/SigBridgeR_workflow.png)

**Current Status**

| Algorithm | Supported Phenotypes | Cache Support | License | Note |
|:--:|:--:|:--:|:--:|:--:|
| [**Scissor**](https://github.com/sunduanchen/Scissor) | `binary` `survival` `continuous` | ✅ | GPL-3 |  |
| [**scPAS**](https://github.com/aiminXie/scPAS) | `binary` `survival` `continuous` |  | GPL-3 |  |
| [**scAB**](https://github.com/jinworks/scAB) | `binary` `survival` `continuous` | ✅ | GPL-3 |  |
| [**scPP**](https://github.com/WangX-Lab/ScPP) | `binary` `survival` `continuous` | ✅ | GPL-3 |  |
| [**DEGAS**](https://github.com/tsteelejohnson91/DEGAS) | `binary` `survival` `continuous` |  | MIT |  |
| [**DEGASv2**](https://github.com/ElliotLiu1997/DEGASv2) | `binary` `survival` `continuous` |  | MIT | Bulk raw counts matrix perferred |
| [**LP-SGL**](https://github.com/hongmeizhanghm/LP_SGL) | `binary` `survival` `continuous` |  | No License |  |
| [**PIPET**](https://github.com/ruan2ruan/PIPET) | `binary` `survival` `continuous` | ✅ | GPL-3 | Bulk raw counts matrix perferred |
| [**SIDISH**](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/mcgilldinglab/SIDISH) | `survival` |  | MIT\* / PolyForm NC 1.0.0 | see [note](#special-declaration-concerning-sidish) below |
| [**SCIPAC**](https://github.com/mianaz/SCIPAC) | `binary` `survival` `continuous` |  | MIT |  |
| [**TiRank**](https://github.com/LenisLin/TiRank) | `binary` `survival` `continuous` | ✅ | MIT |  |
| [**PhenoMapR**](https://github.com/brooksbenard/PhenoMapR) | `binary` `survival` `continuous` |  | MIT |  |

## 🔧 Installatation

We recommend installing the stable branch `version3` from GitHub .

1.  Install stable version 3.x (branch `version3`):

``` r

if (!requireNamespace("pak")) {
  install.packages(
    "pak",
    repos = sprintf(
      "https://r-lib.github.io/p/pak/stable/%s/%s/%s",
      .Platform$pkgType,
      R.Version()$os,
      R.Version()$arch
    )
  )
}
pak::pak("WangLabCSU/SigBridgeR@version3")
```

2.  Install from r-universe:

``` r

install.packages("SigBridgeR", repos = "https://wanglabcsu.r-universe.dev")
```

3.  Install the development version 4 (beta) from GitHub:

``` r

pak::pak("WangLabCSU/SigBridgeR")
```

**unnecessary but recommended**:

For better performance:

``` r

pak::pak(
  # faster computation
  "sparseMatrixStats",
  "matrixStats",
  "preprocessCore",
  "tidyr",
  "matrixTests",
  "KernSmooth",
  "cheapr",
  "WGCNA",
  # better gene symbol conversion
  "scCustomize",
  "huayc09/SeuratExtend"
)
```

For seamless integration with single-cell RNA-seq data stored in
`.h5ad`:

``` r

pak::pak("anndata")
# or
pak::pak("anndataR") # both are supported
```

For visualization:

``` r

pak::pak(c(
  "ggplot2",
  "RColorBrewer",
  "ggupset", # for upset plot
  "patchwork", # for fraction stack plot
  "ggforce", # for pca plot
  "ggVennDiagram" # for venn diagram
))
```

To use the built-in cell annotation methods:

``` r

pak::pak(c(
  # SingleR
  "SingleR-inc/SingleR",
  "celldex",
  # mLLMCelltype
  "mLLMCelltype",
  "plyr",
  # CellTypist
  "reticulate",
  "AnnDataR"
))
```

To add custom extension functions to SigBridgeR:

``` r

pak::pak(c(
  "tictoc",
  "codetools",
  "lintr",
  "rstudioapi"
))
```

## 📓 Get Started

``` r

library(SigBridgeR)
res <- Screen(
  bulk, # bulk RNA expression data
  seurat_obj,
  pheno, # named vector label/survival time data.frame
  screen_method = "scAB", # Algorithm
  phenotype_class = "binary" # or "survival"/"continuous"
)

ggplot2::autoplot(res)
table(res@scRNA_data$scAB)
```

- View [Github Webpage](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/SigBridgeR/)
- Use `?SigBridgeR::function_name` to access the help documents in R.

If you encounter problems, please check:

- the [Troubleshooting
  Guide](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/vignettes/Troubleshooting.md),
  or
- the [Github issues](https://github.com/WangLabCSU/SigBridgeR/issues)
  page if you want to file bug reports or feature requests

Let us know if you have ideas to make this project better. Pull requests
are welcome!

## 🧩 Agent Skills

SigBridgeR ships a set of [Agent Skills](https://skills.sh/) that teach
AI coding agents how to use and extend the package correctly. They live
in the standalone
[`skills/`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/skills) folder and
are installable with the
[`skills`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/skills) CLI (Node.js \>= 22).

| Skill | What it covers |
|:---|:---|
| `sigbridger-screen` | Validate scRNA/bulk/phenotype inputs, choose a registered `ScreenStrategy` method, run [`Screen()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/Screen.md) and read the labelled `Seurat` object from `@scRNA_data` |
| `sigbridger-extend` | Add custom methods: scaffold with [`TemplateScreenFunc()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/TemplateScreenFunc.md), validate with [`ValidateScreenFunc()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/ValidateScreenFunc.md), and register `ScreenMethod`, `AnnotationMethod` and preprocessing steps via [`Register()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/Register.md) |
| `reference-coding` | For contributors: query the local XERJ corpora (upstream screening algorithms, Seurat, Rcpp) before changing analysis code, cite `file:line`, and respect upstream licences |

`reference-coding` relies on the optional XERJ setup documented in
[`AGENTS.md`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/AGENTS.md); the
other two work without it.

Install every skill (interactive: pick the skills and the target
agents):

``` bash
npx skills add WangLabCSU/SigBridgeR
```

Install one skill non-interactively, into a specific agent:

``` bash
npx skills add WangLabCSU/SigBridgeR --skill sigbridger-screen -a codebuddy
```

Install globally so the skills are available in every project on the
machine:

``` bash
npx skills add WangLabCSU/SigBridgeR -g
```

Manage the installed set:

``` bash
npx skills list      # what is installed and where
npx skills check     # are updates available
npx skills update    # pull the latest version
npx skills remove    # uninstall
```

## 🗺️ Similar Projects

[scSurvival](https://github.com/cliffren/scSurvival): Single-cell
expression matrix (log-normalized + HVG-selected) + survival data
(optional clinical covariates and batch labels) -\> Survival-associated
cell subpopulations

[CellPhenoX](https://github.com/fanzhanglab/pyCellPhenoX): Single-cell
multi-omics data + bulk-level clinical variables, covariates (optional
interaction effect terms) -\> interpretable score per cell

[scPrognosis](https://github.com/XiaomeiLi1/scPrognosis): scRNA-seq
count matrix (imputed by MAGIC + filtered for low coverage/expression) +
bulk RNA-seq expression matrix (with matched survival time and event
status) -\> breast cancer prognostic gene signatures and Cox PH risk
prediction model

[SCellBOW](https://github.com/cellsemantics/SCellBOW): source scRNA-seq
expression matrix + target scRNA-seq expression matrix + (optional) bulk
RNA-seq expression matrix with paired survival data -\> cell embeddings,
cluster assignments, UMAP visualizations, and phenotype-algebra-derived
risk scores with survival probability curves for individual cell
subpopulations.

[scPER](https://github.com/BrianLlll/scPER): Single-cell RNA-seq data +
bulk RNA-seq data + celltype annotation (optional batch labels) -\>
phenotype-associated cell populations

## Declaration of Interest

SigBridgeR is distributed under the GNU General Public License version 3
(GPL-3.0). As reflected in the **Current Status** table above,
SigBridgeR integrates algorithms from a number of upstream projects.
SigBridgeR vendors upstream source code only from projects licensed
under **GPL-3.0** or **MIT**, both of which are compatible with GPL-3.0.

All vendored code remains under its original upstream license, and the
corresponding license notices are retained alongside the vendored
sources (e.g. in `inst/vendor/`).

#### Special declaration concerning SIDISH

The license of SIDISH changed during its development:

- At commit `9e9e86e16a08f88f0d4942af0854335b5acbe71b` and **all earlier
  commits**, SIDISH was distributed under the **MIT license**.
- In commits **after** `9e9e86e16a08f88f0d4942af0854335b5acbe71b`,
  SIDISH was relicensed under the **PolyForm Noncommercial License
  1.0.0**. Under that license, noncommercial use is permitted only under
  its complete, unmodified terms, and any use outside those permissions
  requires a separate written agreement with the copyright holders or
  their authorized representatives.

**The SIDISH code vendored in SigBridgeR is taken exclusively from the
MIT-licensed version at or before commit
`9e9e86e16a08f88f0d4942af0854335b5acbe71b`.** SigBridgeR does not
include, copy, modify, or derive from any SIDISH code introduced in
commits after that commit. In particular, **no code under the PolyForm
Noncommercial License 1.0.0 is present in SigBridgeR**. All other
SIDISH-related code in SigBridgeR was independently implemented.

# Package index

## Data Preprocessing

Functions for preprocessing inputs.

- [`SCPreProcess()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/SCPreProcess.md)
  **\[deprecated\]** : Single-Cell RNA-seq Preprocessing Pipeline
- [`QCFilter()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/QCFilter.md)
  : Filter Seurat object cells by QC metrics
- [`QCPatternDetect()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/QCPatternDetect.md)
  : Calculate Percentage of Features Matching Patterns
- [`Pattern2Colname()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/Pattern2Colname.md)
  : convert regex patterns to column names (internal)
- [`SymbolConvert()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/SymbolConvert.md)
  : Convert Ensembles Version IDs & TCGA Version IDs to Genes in Bulk
  Expression Data
- [`AggregateDupRows()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/aggregate-dups.md)
  [`AggregateDupCols()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/aggregate-dups.md)
  [`AggregateDups()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/aggregate-dups.md)
  : Aggregate Rows or Columns with Duplicate Names
- [`SCIntegrate()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/SCIntegrate.md)
  [`SCIntegrate.data.frame()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/SCIntegrate.md)
  [`SCIntegrate.matrix()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/SCIntegrate.md)
  [`SCIntegrate.Seurat()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/SCIntegrate.md)
  : Integrate Single-Cell Datasets
- [`CheckNA()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/CheckNA.md)
  : Check for Missing Values (NA) in Data
- [`PhenoPreProcess()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/PhenoPreProcess.md)
  **\[deprecated\]** : Preprocess Phenotype Data
- [`PhenoMap()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/PhenoMap.md)
  : Map Phenotype Values Using Conditional Rules
- [`CountsToTPM()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/CountsToTPM.md)
  : Convert bulk RNA-seq raw counts to TPM
- [`FPKMToTPM()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/FPKMToTPM.md)
  : Convert bulk RNA-seq FPKM to TPM
- [`GetGeneLength()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/GetGeneLength.md)
  : Compute Gene Lengths from a GTF File or GTF Lines
- [`IsCountsMatrix()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/IsCountsMatrix.md)
  : Check whether a matrix looks like RNA-seq raw counts
- [`IsSkewedDynamic()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/IsSkewedDynamic.md)
  : Test Whether the Proportion of a Target Value Is Highly Skewed

## Result Integration & Visualization

Merge and visualize screening results across methods or conditions.

- [`MergeResult()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/MergeResult.md)
  : Merge Multiple Screening Analysis Results

- [`` `+`( ``*`<SigBridgeR::ScreenMethodResult>`*`)`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/plus-methods.md)
  [`` `+`( ``*`<Seurat>`*`)`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/plus-methods.md)
  :

  Merge two objects with `+`

- [`WeightedVote()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/WeightedVote.md)
  : Weighted Voting Aggregation for Multi-Voter Classification

- [`DrawBulkPCA()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/DrawBulkPCA.md)
  : Draw PCA Plot for Bulk Expression Data

- [`ScreenFractionPlot()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/ScreenFractionPlot.md)
  : Visualization of Cell Screening Fractions

- [`ScreenUpset()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/ScreenUpset.md)
  : ScreenUpset - Visualize cell type intersections from screened Seurat
  object

- [`reexports`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/reexports.md)
  [`autoplot`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/reexports.md)
  : Objects exported from other packages

- [`autoplot(`*`<Seurat>`*`)`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/autoplot-SigBridgeR.md)
  [`autoplot(`*`<SigBridgeR::ScreenMethodResult>`*`)`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/autoplot-SigBridgeR.md)
  : autoplot method for Seurat UMAP

- [`palette_SigBridgeR()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/palette_SigBridgeR.md)
  : A Palette

## Screening Methods

Built-in screening algorithms.

- [`Screen()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/Screen.md)
  : Single-Cell Data Screening
- [`DoLP_SGL()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/DoLP_SGL.md)
  : Perform LP-SGL Screening Analysis
- [`DoPIPET()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/DoPIPET.md)
  : Perform PIPET Screening Analysis
- [`DoScissor()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/DoScissor.md)
  : Perform Scissor Screening Analysis
- [`DoscAB()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/DoscAB.md)
  : Perform scAB Screening Analysis
- [`DoscPAS()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/DoscPAS.md)
  : Perform scPAS Screening Analysis
- [`DoscPP()`](https://wanglabcsu.github.io/sigbridger/reference/DoscPP.md)
  : Perform scPP screening analysis
